Needs changes before merge.

## What looks good

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/stock_page.rs:116-123` writes the shown part into `state.stock_ui.source` only when the two strings differ. Still frames do not allocate or write.
- The indexing uses `models.get(idx).or(models.last())` after the `models.is_empty()` guard. It avoids panics on out-of-range indices.
- `state.stock_ui` remains transient draft state. World changes still go through `CommandKind::SetStockPose` on Apply.
- `docs/decisions/3261-stock-source-default.md` records the decision, the reason, the dropped options, and the cost to change.
- Commit format, `Changelog:` line, and `Fixes #3261` match project rules. No snapshot PNGs, process files, dependencies, or `CHANGELOG.md` entries changed.

## Results merged with main

All builds and tests ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3268`. The branch is already up to date with `upstream/main` (`6e1805bfdae52fcfea71a946d381dfbfdefc79f5`) and merges with no conflicts. No GitHub runner or workflow was used.

## Heavy lanes

## Safety tier

- Not applicable. The diff changes no posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation, or geometry. No goldens changed.

## Requested before merge

1. **PR body (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/stock_page.rs:116-123`):** Add before and after screenshots of the Stock page to the PR body. This PR changes UI code in `crates/ui`, so both screenshots are required. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch, and link them from the PR body. Do not commit image files to this PR branch.
2. **`crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/stock_source_default.rs:13` (and lines `44-56`):** Build `apply_from_model` from `ShellUi::blank()` instead of `shell_harness()`. `shell_harness()` calls `ShellUi::seeded()`, which already imports `"Block"` and creates a fitted box stock. Because of that seed, `from_model_apply_takes_the_only_part_shown` tests two models (`"Block"` and `"box"`) with existing stock, not one part in an empty project as #3261 specifies. Use `Harness::builder().with_size(Vec2::new(1280.0, 720.0)).build_ui_state(frame, ShellUi::blank())` (as `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/stock_size.rs:48-50` does) so the one-part test has exactly one model and no prior stock. Assert that the model count is 1 in the one-part test, and assert that the rendered UI shows the part name before Apply (for example with `query_by_label`).

## Notes

- No PR code was changed and nothing was pushed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
